title: Memory facts should be addable, searchable, and deletable from the launcher
body: Add backend support for creating, deleting, and searching memory facts, including standing reminders and vault-sync cleanup for deleted facts, so the launcher can manage memory without hand-editing files.
interface: memory facts capability exposes POST and DELETE routes and updates the fact store/vault sync consistently.
why: Memory maintenance is central to Mana being self-sustaining.
